meta.description: La Labranza, the live-cooking, tableside-storytelling restaurant of Viña La Quirinca — traditional Chilean cuisine cooked and narrated at your table on a boutique winery estate near Santiago.

home.headline: La Labranza
home.subhead: A tableside table — dinner cooked, explained, and poured in front of you.
home.valueProp: Traditional Chilean cuisine, told as a story: each course prepared and narrated at your table, paired with wine grown on the estate you're sitting on.
home.highlight1: Every glass starts in these vines
home.highlight2: Alpacas graze just beyond the dining room
